description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with sensor endpoints, including resource extraction, fault status checking, bypass status checking, and event-based status updates within a device management context.

methods.name: extractResource
methods.description: Extracts a resource value from a hash map based on a URI and resource name.

methods.name: isEndpointFaulted
methods.description: Checks if a DSEndpoint is faulted by examining its resources.

methods.name: isEndpointFaultedViaEvent
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint is faulted based on a resource update event.

methods.name: isEndpointBypassed
methods.description: Checks if a DSEndpoint is bypassed by examining its resources.

methods.name: isEndpointBypassedViaEvent
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint is bypassed based on a resource update event.
